calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - Intro
calls.summary: In this introductory call, GrowthBook (Daniel, co-founder Graham, and sales lead Ryan) discussed their experimentation platform with Customer.io's growth marketing team (Pino, Gabby) and demand gen lead Elliot. Key pain points included manual data stitching between Customer.io, Snowflake, Mixpanel, and Sigma, as well as the inability to run product experiments without engineering support, which GrowthBook's visual editor and self-serve features aim to solve. Next steps include Daniel sharing the call recording, additional resources, and a booking link for a deeper demo, with a recommendation to include engineers and the head of growth.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - Demo
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, sales; Graham, CEO) demonstrated its visual editor and warehouse-native measurement to Customer.io’s team (Gabby Kustner, Elliot Shaw, Casey Kennedy), addressing their pain point of manually stitching experiment results across Snowflake, Sigma, and Mixpanel. Next steps include setting up a trial environment, establishing a Slack channel, and running initial experiments on the marketing website and signup flow, with a follow-up readout scheduled for Friday.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - POC Sync
calls.summary: The call focused on resolving issues with GrowthBook's Visual Editor during a POC with Customer.io. Key participants included Daniel Wathne, Bryce Fitzsimons, and Logan Bates from GrowthBook, and Pino Nguyen, Abigail Bullinger, and Elliot Shaw from Customer.io. They discussed limitations of the Visual Editor for complex changes (e.g., dynamic content, full page makeovers) and SDK connection problems. Next steps include fixing the SDK connection, following up with engineers to run Elliot's experiment via feature flags, addressing metrics integration, and extending the trial timeline to ensure a successful evaluation.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - Sync
calls.summary: GrowthBook discussed a missing event forwarding feature for Snowflake, which caused exposure data not to be logged for a running experiment with Customer.io. Key participants included Logan Bates and Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook) and Pino Nguyen (Customer.io). Next steps are to pause the experiment, implement a short-term solution using GrowthBook's managed warehouse with metric data via API, and build a permanent Snowflake event forwarder, while also scheduling a call between leadership to discuss contract terms (15 seats, opt-out by May).
